# Plugin source files that keep a third-party copyright notice instead of the
# plugin header (FAB-5, WP-F4). Read by Build/Scripts/check-copyright-headers.py.
#
# Only for genuine third-party code (copied or vendored from elsewhere) that
# is not under a ThirdParty/ directory; ThirdParty/ trees and generated files
# are skipped without an entry here.
#
# One file per line: the path relative to the plugin root, whitespace, then
# the reason (required), e.g.
#   Source/SomeModule/Private/Foo.cpp  zlib licence, copied from <project> <version>
# Blank lines and lines starting with '#' are ignored. An entry for a file git
# does not track fails the check.
#
# No entries: every .h/.cpp/.cs outside ThirdParty/ is first-party.
